description: This file defines a FastAPI application with data models and an API endpoint that updates an item with additional user and importance parameters.

classes.name: Item
classes.description: Pydantic model representing an item with name, description, price, and tax attributes.

classes.name: User
classes.description: Pydantic model representing a user with username and full_name attributes.

methods.name: update_item(item_id: int, item: Item, user: User, importance: int = Body())
methods.description: Asynchronous API endpoint that updates an item with provided item ID, item details, user info, and importance level.

ctags.name: update_item
ctags.pattern: /^async def update_item(item_id: int, item: Item, user: User, importance: int = Body()):$/
ctags.signature: (item_id: int, item: Item, user: User, importance: int = Body())
